Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the center lane of a multi-lane roadway in Baytown, Texas, when the vehicle moved left to
change lanes and made contact with the side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was in the adjacent lane. Driver 1 is the
named insured on the policy involved. Responding officers observed scrape marks and paint transfer along the right
rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the side-to-side contact described by both drivers, and the
damage pattern is in line with the impact reported. Photographs taken at the scene show the vehicle positions and
confirm several of the details given by the drivers. No independent witnesses were located, and no prior damage to
either vehicle was known to the parties or observed at the scene. Passenger reported neck and upper back pain
consistent with whiplash and said the force of the contact therw them against the seat. Passenger's exact seating
position in the vehicle could not be fully established during the interview, and the account given on that point was not
entirely clear. Passenger was transported for evaluation. Officers did not issue a citation at the scene, and the matter
was documented for review.
